instructions:
- After code, feature, dependency, or build configuration changes, agents must run npm run build before reporting completion. Fix build failures and rerun the build; if blocked, report the actual failure and do not claim completion.
- Agents must not deploy, run the mew launcher, or start, stop, or restart servers. The user performs those operations.
- Type checks, tests, lint, and documentation checks are also required as applicable. Documentation-only changes do not require an app build.
- These instructions apply only to the Mew source repository. Follow .mew/docs/development/getting-started.md for details.
